modules.title: Public Health Records
modules.blurb: A clinical record rests under the patient consent that governs it, and every reading of it leaves a trail the patient sees.
longDescription: The module holds the health records a public service keeps, the consent a patient gives over each one, and the access log every reading writes.
A clinical record moves between services with no consent attached and no record of who read it.

reasonByDepId.civil-registry: The civil register names the person a health record belongs to.
reasonByDepId.privacy-compliance: The guard rules narrow a reading to the fields a consent admits.
reasonByDepId.evidence-chain: The evidence chain anchors an image or a scan referenced by a clinical entry.

modules.title: Welfare Delivery
modules.blurb: A household entitlement, every payment made against it and every appeal raised rest in one record the household and the auditor both read.
longDescription: The module holds the welfare programmes a government runs, the household entitlements under each one, the payments released, and the appeals a household raises.
A benefit reaches a list nobody outside the office can check and a household has no way to question it.

reasonByDepId.civil-registry: The civil register names the people inside a household.
reasonByDepId.kyc-utility-registry: A shared identity attestation confirms a household member without a fresh document check.
reasonByDepId.indexer-sink: The index store answers an office report across every programme at once.

modules.title: Permit Issuance
modules.blurb: An application for a permit carries its checks, its decision and its conditions in one record the applicant follows from the first day.
longDescription: The module holds the permit kinds an authority issues, the applications people make, the checks each one passes, and the permit and its conditions.
An applicant chases an office for a decision nobody can date.

reasonByDepId.civil-registry: The civil register names the applicant behind a permit application.
reasonByDepId.evidence-chain: The evidence chain anchors the plans and photographs attached to an application.
reasonByDepId.indexer-sink: The index store answers a public search over permits by address.

modules.title: Licence Register
modules.blurb: A trade licence, a professional licence and their renewals rest in one public register anybody checks in a moment.
longDescription: The module holds the licence classes a regulator issues, the licences themselves, the renewal record, and the sanctions placed against a holder.
A member of the public takes a licence claim on trust and a regulator finds a lapse months later.

reasonByDepId.civil-registry: The civil register names the person or the business behind a licence.
reasonByDepId.permit-issuance: A permit covers one activity while a licence covers a standing right to trade.
reasonByDepId.indexer-sink: The index store answers a public licence search by name or address.

modules.title: Inter Department Transfer
modules.blurb: A case, a budget line and a duty move between departments with both sides recording the handover on the same record.
longDescription: The module holds the transfers moving between departments, the acceptance each receiving department records, and the standing agreement that permits the movement.
A file leaves one department and arrives at another with two versions of what was sent.

reasonByDepId.civil-registry: A case file about a person names the civil record behind it.
reasonByDepId.evidence-chain: The evidence chain anchors the documents a case file carries across departments.
reasonByDepId.indexer-sink: The index store answers a search for every transfer touching one case.

modules.title: Public Ballot and Tally
modules.blurb: A public vote publishes its roll, its sealed ballots and its count, so any observer recomputes the result.
longDescription: The module holds the ballots a returning officer opens, the sealed votes cast at each station, and the counts an observer recomputes from the published record.
A result arrives as a number and an observer checks nothing.

reasonByDepId.civil-registry: The civil register supplies the roll a ballot is opened against.
reasonByDepId.evidence-chain: The evidence chain anchors the paper records a recount reads.
reasonByDepId.indexer-sink: The index store lets an observer recompute a national total in one pass.

answers.question: What are we building?
answers.answer: An evidence record that carries every movement and every viewing of an item.
answers.why: A gap in the handling record is what defeats evidence in court, so the model records each step.

answers.question: Who uses it?
answers.answer: Custodians book in and seal. Case officers take and return. Courts read the custody record during proceedings.
answers.why: The court reads a narrow projection of the record, which is the part proceedings need.

answers.question: What has to be true on day one?
answers.answer: Every movement names a taker and a place, and a sealed item opens on a court order alone.
answers.why: Those two rules carry the chain of custody the law expects.

answers.question: How does the system reach the outside world?
answers.answer: The system reaches no outside network. The package installs from media and carries every dependency with it.
answers.why: A Government deployment runs inside an air gapped site, so every part travels in the package rather than over a connection.

answers.why: The residency lock is enforced at the infrastructure layer and the manifest records it, so a reviewer reads the position rather than asking for it.

answers.why: Governance across organisations is standard for Government, so one department changes the shared record with the others agreeing.
